statement: This sketch creates two distinct particle streams that flow independently across the canvas with vibrant, contrasting colors. Each stream maintains its own identity while exhibiting fluid, liquid-like motion through gentle random movements and boundary bouncing. The key interaction occurs when particles from different streams come into close proximity—triggering a temporary color exchange where particles briefly adopt the hue of their neighboring stream before resuming their original colors. This creates an elegant visual tension between the two flows, emphasizing both their individual characteristics and their dynamic relationship as they cross paths.
